newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds to be capped by 111-29.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds to be capped by 111-29.

text.p: September T-bond futures will look to continue their pull back on Friday, with any upside potential blocked by 111-29, technical analysts said.
"We got close to the 113 objective and now it has turned so I'm looking for a correction of the rally," said Steve Merrigan, technical analyst at First Chicago in London.
The contract touched a high at 112-24 on June 20 in an attempt to rally up to the mid-February highs around 113-04/09.
"Resistance at 111-29 keeps the outlook negative," he said.
At 0942 GMT, September T-bond futures were at 111-10 in automated trade, up 5/32 from Thursday's Chicago settlement.
Merrigan set initial resistance at around 111-19.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Markets in London was more positive longer term. He said T-bonds had hit an intial downside objective at around 111-00.
"But we could see more of a short-covering rally which is developing now," he said. "This is going to start hitting resistance around the 111-17 area," he said.
Daily charts show lows here on June 17, 18 and a low of 111-18 on July 25.
To the downside, Merrigan said he was looking for weakenss through 111-03/05 to target 110-23 and then 110-05.
On Thursday, the daily low was at 111-04 and T-bonds closed just off that level at 110-05.
But Adcock said the longer-term trend was positive and he would use setbacks to buy.
"The chances are we can see the market down to the 110-16 to 110-12 area over the next couple of days," he said, adding that region marked the lower limits of the current trading range.
At 1005 GMT, December Eurodollars were at 93.940, up 0.010 on the day.
